title: Answer extraction (schema version 2)
description: How the user's reply answers the one question asked. Code applies it; the model never chooses areas, creates items or decides readiness.

value.description: What they said, in a short plain sentence. Null unless answered or partial.

quote.description: The user's exact words, copied from one message they sent. Null if there's nothing to quote.

check.description: Only for a check or confirmation question: yes, no or unclear. Otherwise none.

wrap_up.description: True only if the user asked to stop or wrap up.

area.description: A coverage ID from the list given.

quote.description: The user's exact words, copied from one message they sent.
